items.title: Zelensky says new peace talks could take place during G20 summit
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said another round of peace talks could take place during the G20 summit, according to a report on his remarks. The statement indicated a possible venue and timing, not an agreed meeting or confirmed negotiating schedule.

items.title: Latvian prime minister reportedly rules out normal relations with Russia after war
items.summary: Latvia's prime minister said relations with Russia would not return to normal even after a ceasefire or the end of the war in Ukraine, according to a Russian-language report. He argued that European policy toward Moscow had fundamentally changed and reiterated opposition to resuming dialogue without pressure.

items.title: Russian Foreign Ministry criticizes Google's reported suspension of fact-checking group
items.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry said Google had reportedly suspended the Global Fact-Checking Network's account indefinitely and criticized the move as politically motivated censorship. The ministry suggested a possible connection to the group's disputed claims about killings in Bucha, but provided no evidence establishing Google's motive.
